lots.guide_summary: 0 sold, 0 unsold, 2 asking. Both are primary gallery retail asks for new Viney canvases (verified on the page). No auction result for any Viney painting was found (Gowans API: none; Artrecord record price hidden). Retail asks are not a guide to auction value; a realistic Tasmanian auction outcome is unknown and likely a small fraction of these. All AUD, rate 1.0.
lots.working: No SOLD evidence, so keep and flip maximums are 0. Armitage premium 22% (all-in = hammer x 1.22) noted for when evidence exists.
lots.confidence_reason: Attribution rests on the catalogue title only; no signature or label read in photos; only retail asking prices; no auction record found.
lots.dropped_entries: Gallery Pejean (https://www.gallerypejean.com.au/Artists/RYLLTONVINEY/VIEWARTWORK.aspx): dropped, page now returns HTTP 404 and the $2,500 was snippet only, never verified. Artrecord placeholder (https://www.artrecord.com/index.cfm/artist/10998-viney-ryllton/): dropped, carries no price (it was a watercolour, price hidden), and a 'no result found' note is not an UNSOLD result. WebSearch session cap was hit during verification, so no further Armitage or Invaluable searches were possible.
lots.key_photo_findings: Three front views only. Heavily textured surface with grit, scraped and incised black marks, a pale central block. Cropped and enlarged the lower edge and corners: no signature, monogram or date visible on the front. Canvas edges appear unpainted grey; no frame. Verso not shown.
lots.condition: Appears sound from the front; no obvious tears or losses seen, minor surface scuffs possible on lower edge. Back and stretcher not shown.
lots.question_for_armitage: Is it signed, dated or titled on the back or stretcher (the catalogue says 2023 Rylton Viney), and is there a gallery label (Madeline Gordon or other)? What are the dimensions, and any damage to the canvas or edges?

lots.condition: Good overall from photos; leaf colour mismatch; minor finish wear; mechanism and underside not shown.
lots.question_for_armitage: How many leaves come with it and what is the full extended and closed length? Is it mahogany (catalogue says ash)? Do the leaves fit properly and do the pedestals separate for transport? Any maker's label underneath?
